rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for describing someone acting in a deceitful or treacherous way.

example.english: They act treacherously, pretending to be your friend while betraying you behind your back.
example.traditional: 佢表面同你講好兄弟，背後就陰險咁出賣你。
